title: Area of Rectangle
description: Calculates the area enclosed by a rectangle using its length and breadth.

example.question: Find the area of a rectangle with length 12 cm and breadth 5 cm.

note: Area is measured in square units.

title: Perimeter of Rectangle
description: Calculates the total length of the boundary of a rectangle.

example.question: Find the perimeter of a rectangle with length 10 cm and breadth 4 cm.

note: Perimeter is measured in linear units.

title: Diagonal of Rectangle
description: Calculates the diagonal of a rectangle using the Pythagorean theorem.

example.question: Find the diagonal of a rectangle with length 8 cm and breadth 6 cm.

note: Derived using the Pythagorean theorem.

title: Area of Square
description: Calculates the area enclosed by a square using its side length.

example.question: Find the area of a square with side 9 cm.

note: All four sides of a square are equal.

title: Perimeter of Square
description: Calculates the total length of the boundary of a square.

example.question: Find the perimeter of a square with side 7 cm.

note: Perimeter is four times the side length.

title: Diagonal of Square
description: Calculates the diagonal of a square from its side length.

example.question: Find the diagonal of a square with side 10 cm.

note: Derived using the Pythagorean theorem.

title: Area of Triangle
description: Calculates the area of a triangle using its base and perpendicular height.

example.question: Find the area of a triangle with base 14 cm and height 8 cm.

note: Height must be perpendicular to the base.

title: Perimeter of Triangle
description: Calculates the total length of the boundary of a triangle.

example.question: Find the perimeter of a triangle with sides 5 cm, 6 cm and 7 cm.

note: Perimeter is the sum of all three sides.

title: Semi-Perimeter of Triangle
description: Calculates half of the triangle's perimeter. It is mainly used in Heron's formula.

example.question: Find the semi-perimeter of a triangle with sides 6 cm, 8 cm and 10 cm.

note: Semi-perimeter is represented by the symbol 's'.

title: Heron's Formula
description: Calculates the area of a triangle using the lengths of all three sides.

example.question: Find the area of a triangle with sides 5 cm, 12 cm and 13 cm.

note: Use Heron's formula when the three sides are known but the height is not.

title: Area of Parallelogram
description: Calculates the area enclosed by a parallelogram using its base and perpendicular height.

example.question: Find the area of a parallelogram with base 15 cm and height 8 cm.

note: The height must be perpendicular to the base.

title: Perimeter of Parallelogram
description: Calculates the total length of the boundary of a parallelogram.

example.question: Find the perimeter of a parallelogram with sides 9 cm and 6 cm.

note: Opposite sides of a parallelogram are equal.

title: Area of Rhombus
description: Calculates the area of a rhombus using the lengths of its diagonals.

example.question: Find the area of a rhombus with diagonals 16 cm and 10 cm.

note: The diagonals of a rhombus bisect each other at right angles.

title: Perimeter of Rhombus
description: Calculates the total length of the boundary of a rhombus.

example.question: Find the perimeter of a rhombus with side 11 cm.

note: All four sides of a rhombus are equal.

title: Area of Trapezium
description: Calculates the area of a trapezium using the lengths of its parallel sides and perpendicular height.

example.question: Find the area of a trapezium with parallel sides 8 cm and 14 cm and height 6 cm.

note: Only the parallel sides are used in the formula.

title: Perimeter of Trapezium
description: Calculates the total length of the boundary of a trapezium.

example.question: Find the perimeter of a trapezium with sides 8 cm, 14 cm, 5 cm and 7 cm.

note: Perimeter is the sum of all four sides.

title: Area of Kite
description: Calculates the area of a kite using the lengths of its diagonals.

example.question: Find the area of a kite with diagonals 18 cm and 12 cm.

note: The diagonals of a kite intersect at right angles.

title: Perimeter of Kite
description: Calculates the total length of the boundary of a kite.

variables.meaning: Length of one pair of equal sides
Length of the other pair of equal sides

example.question: Find the perimeter of a kite with equal side pairs of 8 cm and 5 cm.

note: A kite has two pairs of adjacent equal sides.

title: Area of Circle
description: Calculates the area enclosed by a circle using its radius.

example.question: Find the area of a circle with radius 7 cm.

note: Use π ≈ 3.14 or 22/7 depending on the problem.

title: Circumference of Circle
description: Calculates the distance around a circle.

example.question: Find the circumference of a circle with radius 7 cm.

note: The circumference is the perimeter of a circle.

title: Area of Semicircle
description: Calculates the area enclosed by a semicircle.

example.question: Find the area of a semicircle with radius 7 cm.

note: A semicircle is half of a circle.

title: circumference of Semicircle
description: Calculates the total boundary length of a semicircle, including the diameter.

example.question: Find the perimeter of a semicircle with radius 7 cm.

note: Perimeter = Half Circumference + Diameter.

title: Arc Length of Semicircle
description: Calculates the length of the curved portion of a semicircle.

example.question: Find the arc length of a semicircle with radius 7 cm.

note: Arc length excludes the diameter.

title: Area of Sector
description: Calculates the area of a sector using its central angle and radius.

example.question: Find the area of a sector with radius 7 cm and central angle 90°.

note: The central angle determines the fraction of the circle.

title: circumference of Sector
description: Calculates the total boundary length of a sector using its two radii and arc length.

example.question: Find the perimeter of a sector with radius 7 cm and arc length 11 cm.

note: Perimeter = Two radii + Arc length.

title: Arc Length of Sector
description: Calculates the length of the curved boundary of a sector.

example.question: Find the arc length of a sector with radius 7 cm and central angle 90°.

note: Arc length is the corresponding fraction of the circle's circumference.

title: Area of Segment
description: Calculates the area of the minor segment of a circle by subtracting the area of the triangle from the area of the corresponding sector.

example.question: Find the area of the segment of a circle with radius 7 cm and central angle 90°.

note: Area of Segment = Area of Sector − Area of Triangle. For angles given in radians, use A = ½r²(θ − sinθ).
